sentences.text: Vietnam -LRB- ˌ ; -LSB- vîət nāːm -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Socialist Republic of Vietnam -LRB- SRV ; , is the easternmost country on the Indochina Peninsula in Southeast Asia .	Indochina Peninsula	Indochina	Southeast Asia	Southeast Asia

With an estimated 92.7 million inhabitants , it is the world 's 14th-most-populous country , and the ninth-most-populous Asian country .	14th-most-populous country	List of countries and dependencies by population	ninth-most-populous Asian country	List of Asian countries by population

Vietnam is bordered by China to the north , Laos to the northwest , Cambodia to the southwest , Thailand across the Gulf of Thailand to the southwest , and the Philippines , Malaysia and Indonesia across the South China Sea to the east and southeast .	China	China	Laos	Laos	Cambodia	Cambodia	Thailand	Thailand	Gulf of Thailand	Gulf of Thailand	Philippines	Philippines	Malaysia	Malaysia	Indonesia	Indonesia	South China Sea	South China Sea

Its capital city has been Hanoi since the reunification of North and South Vietnam in 1976 , with Ho Chi Minh City as a historical city as well .	Hanoi	Hanoi	Ho Chi Minh City	Ho Chi Minh City	capital city	capital city	North	North Vietnam	South Vietnam	South Vietnam
The northern part of Vietnam was part of Imperial China for over a millennium , from 111 BC to AD 939 .	China	China	Imperial China	Imperial China

An independent Vietnamese state was formed in 939 , following a Vietnamese victory in the Battle of Bạch Đằng River .	Vietnamese	Vietnamese people	Battle of Bạch Đằng River	Battle of Bạch Đằng River (938)

Successive Vietnamese imperial dynasties flourished as the nation expanded geographically and politically into Southeast Asia , until the Indochina Peninsula was colonized by the French in the mid-19th century .	Vietnamese	Vietnamese people	Indochina Peninsula	Indochina	Southeast Asia	Southeast Asia	Vietnamese imperial dynasties	List of Vietnamese monarchs	colonized by the French	French Indochina

Following a Japanese occupation in the 1940s , the Vietnamese fought French rule in the First Indochina War , eventually expelling the French in 1954 .	Vietnamese	Vietnamese people	Japanese occupation	Japanese invasion of French Indochina	First Indochina War	First Indochina War

Thereafter , Vietnam was divided politically into two rival states , North Vietnam -LRB- officially the Democratic Republic of Vietnam -RRB- , and South Vietnam -LRB- officially the Republic of Vietnam -RRB- .	North	North Vietnam	South Vietnam	South Vietnam	North Vietnam	North Vietnam
Conflict between the two sides intensified in what is known as the Vietnam War .	Vietnam War	Vietnam War
The war ended with a North Vietnamese victory in 1975 .	Vietnamese	Vietnamese people	North	North Vietnam
Vietnam was then unified under a communist government but remained impoverished and politically isolated .	communist	Communism
In 1986 , the government initiated a series of economic and political reforms which began Vietnam 's path towards integration into the world economy .	economic and political reforms	Doi Moi
By 2000 , it had established diplomatic relations with all nations .

Since 2000 , Vietnam 's economic growth rate has been among the highest in the world , and , in 2011 , it had the highest Global Growth Generators Index among 11 major economies .	Global Growth Generators Index	3G (countries)
Its successful economic reforms resulted in its joining the World Trade Organization in 2007 .	World Trade Organization	World Trade Organization

It is also a member of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation and the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie .	Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation	Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation	Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie	Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie

Vietnam remains one of the world 's four remaining one-party socialist states officially espousing communism .	one-party	One-party state	socialist	socialist state	socialist states officially espousing communism	socialist state
